message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in for you without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way to regain access is to use the “Forgot password?” or “Reset password” link on the login page. That will send a password‑reset email to the address associated with your account, allowing you to set a new password securely.

If you’re having trouble locating the reset option or need further assistance, let me know and I’ll guide you through the steps!
